channel.title: RGUHS MD Pharmacology — Practicals, Narrated
channel.itunes:author: Dr. Harshad Ramineni
channel.description: Narrated model answers for the RGUHS MD Pharmacology practical examination, kept apart from the theory-exam show. Season 1, protocol writing: eight model protocols, from a phase 2 anxiolytic trial to phase 3 registration programmes, each with its design, sample size, visit schedule, analysis, Indian regulatory and ethics requirements, and viva points. Season 2, experimental pharmacology: laboratory animals and ethics, laboratory and sophisticated instruments, and the in vivo experiments of Medhi's Practical Manual, one episode per item. Season 3, bioassay: the principles, the designs and their calculations worked from the textbook's own numbers, the isolated tissues and every determine-the-unknown-concentration experiment, and the isolated heart. About 20 hours 31 minutes.
channel.itunes:summary: Narrated practical-exam answers for MD Pharmacology. Season 1 is protocol writing; season 2 is experimental pharmacology; season 3 is bioassay.
